{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.06

|gr1= System

|descr= Return texture information - resolution in pixels (mipmap level 0) and average colour. Multiply the pixel values by [[pixelW]] and [[pixelH]] to get screen coordinates.

|s1= [[getTextureInfo]] texture

|p1= texture: [[String]] - texture path (.paa, .jpg, .ogv)

|r1= [[Array]] with [width, height, rgbaAverageColour]
* width: [[Number]]
* height: [[Number]]
* {{GVI|arma3|2.08|size= 0.75}} rgbaAverageColour: [[Color|Color (RGBA)]]


|s2= [[getTextureInfo]] [texture, sizeH]
|s2since=arma3 2.22
|p21= texture: [[String]] - texture path (.paa, .jpg, .ogv)
|p22= sizeH: [[Number]] - texture height in screen size

|r2= [[Array]] with [width, height]
* width: [[Number]] - width of the texture in screen units
* height: [[Number]] - height of the texture in screen units

|x1= <sqf>getTextureInfo "a3\characters_f\blufor\data\clothing1_co.paa"; // [2048, 2048, [0.458824, 0.427451, 0.34902, 1]]</sqf>
|x2= <sqf>getTextureInfo ["\A3\UI_f\Data\Logos\arma3_shadow_ca.paa", 0.1]; // [0.150111, 0.1]</sqf>

|seealso= [[pixelW]] [[pixelH]] [[getModelInfo]] [[supportInfo]] [[getObjectType]] [[getObjectTextures]]
}}
